content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial is for missing required authorization; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. The codes and billing order are valid, so resubmitting would not address the denial, while a formal medical-necessity appeal is available. Appeal before determining any collectible contractual patient responsibility, since the remaining deductible alone does not make this authorization denial patient-billable.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
